title: Contents Packout & Storage — Number of Return Loads
content:
The return loads of a Contents Packout & Storage job follow what is left in the vaults: **when a disposal haul line stands on the job and the job's signed disposal authorizations list at least one item, the return loads are found by taking the boxes packed less the items listed on signed disposal authorizations, each listed item counting as one packed box, dividing that difference by the tier's vault capacity and rounding up to a whole load, never fewer than one; when no disposal haul line stands on the job and the vault count recorded on the job is greater than the boxes packed divided by the tier's vault capacity and rounded up, the return loads are that rounded-up figure; in every other case the return loads are the vault count recorded on the job.**

This governs the truck loads that bring home the contents of Partial, Full and High-Value Contents Packout and Commercial Contents and Records Recovery jobs.

## Input – judgement – loads

1. Is there a disposal haul line on the job, and do the job's signed disposal authorizations list at least one item? If both: loads are the boxes packed less the listed items, divided by the tier's vault capacity, rounded up, never fewer than 1.
2. Otherwise, if there is no disposal haul line and the recorded vault count is greater than the boxes packed divided by capacity rounded up: loads are that rounded-up figure.
3. In every other case: loads are the vault count recorded on the job.

## Cases (hypothetical capacity of 100 boxes per vault)

| Disposal haul line | Items listed on signed authorizations | Boxes packed | Recorded vaults | Return loads |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 140 | 410 | 5 | 410 less 140 is 270, divided by 100 rounded up: 3 |
| yes | 40 | 30 | 1 | never fewer than 1: 1 |
| no | — | 410 | 6 | 410 divided by 100 rounded up is 5; 6 is greater: 5 |
| no | — | 410 | 5 | 5 |
| yes | none | 410 | 6 | 6 |
